notes.title: Turn-based mode added to game!
notes.content:
This update brings several quality of life improvements along with the addition of turn-based mode.  Only the most hardcore should attempt turn-based without teleports - unlike the arcade version, you only move at the same speed as your enemies! Four new achievements have been added for this mode, taking the total possibly achievements up to 20.

The menu screen has received a major addition of shininess and a couple of little additions that should make the game more enjoyable - like a visual indicator and tiny pause when you teleport, and a timer bar for when you receive extra points just for surviving (that doesn't last forever or you could just lead the last remaining enemy a merry dance while racking up points, and that would never do!)

The scoring algorithms have been tweaked slightly to make it a bit easier to hit some of the achievements -)


[u]Changelog (v2.15)
[/u]
[b]New features:
[/b]
- turn-based mode added
- 4 new achievements linked to completing levels in turn-based mode
- timer bar showing when bonus score still available for staying alive
- music on / off selection added to menu screen

[b]Updates:
[/b]
- spruced up menu screen
- shinier mouse cursor
- visible pointer for teleport destination and tiny game pause to allow for orientation
- scoring algorithms tweaked - slightly higher scores will be possible
- bonus score added for completing levels in Challenge Mode to aid getting achievements

[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
- Minus scores not possible at start of levels
- enemies and objects can no longer appear outside the arena border (actually not 100% fixed, will resolve this on later update)
- other small background fixes
